title: DERC Lets Delhi Discoms Recover Fuel Surcharge Above the 10% Cap for June 2026
case_name: In re: Fuel and Power Purchase Cost Adjustment Surcharge for BRPL, BYPL and TPDDL, June 2026
card_summary: DERC relaxed its usual 10% cap on monthly fuel and power purchase cost surcharge recovery for June 2026, invoking its power to relax tariff regulations in exceptional circumstances. Against requirements the discoms reported running well above the cap, the commission allowed BRPL to recover 17.94%, BYPL 17.43% and TPDDL 18.50% for that month, with the extra recovery confined to that one billing cycle.
card_tip: A discom seeking FPPAS relief above the standard cap should cite the specific relaxation power and tie the relief to one billing month, since DERC has granted it cycle by cycle, not as a standing dispensation.
verification_notes: Order date (10 August 2026), the figures for June 2026 (BRPL 17.94%, BYPL 17.43%, TPDDL 18.50%), and the one-month, cap-relaxation basis of the order are corroborated across Solar Quarter, Business Today and Outlook Business. Business Today's URL dateline differs from its reported content date; the June 2026 figures match the Solar Quarter report specifically covering the 10 August order.
